article.title: Brazil: André Janones and the reinvention of political mobilization on social media
article.author: Editor
article.content: Few figures in contemporary Brazilian politics have managed to translate the logic of digital networks into concrete political action as effectively as Federal Deputy André Janones (Rede Sustentabilidade Party—Minas Gerais). The post Brazil: André Janones and the reinvention of political mobilization on social media appeared first on MR Online .
